thread:
ajay: quick note — we should add a cache-adjusted unit-cost card to the econ dashboard for the console. the per-token card right now hides when a route is ~50% KV-prefetch hits and the apparent "expensive" model is actually cheap on gpu time.
clare: yes, this. saw a customer surprised by a 3x delta last week. can we show raw token charges + cache credit line? :eyes:
ben: do we mean a separate card or an overlay toggle? overlay might be simpler initially (show "effective cost" vs "raw cost").
ajay: overlay toggle is fine for v1. backend needs to emit both metrics per-invocation: total_tokens, billed_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_credit_usd. minimal API change: include cache_credits in telem.
kevin: adding to telemetry contract will affect sampling. we currently sample 1/100 for high-throughput routes. if we need accurate amortized cache credits we may need a higher sample or deterministic sampling per-tenant.
clare: agreed. can we instead compute cache-adjusted at ingest (router) where exact hits are known and then mark sampled events? cheaper to compute at router than recompute in offline.
ben: small sketch of API shape for router -> billing ingest:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "total_tokens": 1200,
  "billed_tokens": 480,
  "cache_hit_tokens": 720,
  "cache_credit_usd": 0.072,
  "cache_credit_policy": "amortize"
}
```
ajay: perfect. UX asks for two numbers: "Raw unit cost" (cost/token without credits) and "Effective unit cost" (cost after cache credits and amortized warmup). also an annotation for when prefetch/shared-cache was used.
kevin: caveat: amortization windows differ by model variant & warmup strategy. we'll need a small enum in the payload so console can show the correct tooltip (e.g., "amortize:24h", "min-50-invocations").
clare: will the routing logic need to change? if console shows a lower effective cost, ops might reroute to 'cheaper' variants and starve prefetch budgets. we need routing hysteresis + quota awareness.
ben: yes — suggestion: routing policy reads a new field from the cost API: `prefetch_budget_remaining` and `prefetch_effective_cost_delta`. if prefetch budget low, routing should avoid decisions that increase prefetch pressure. small heuristics first.
ajay: operational checklist for this feature:
- telemetry contract update and sampling plan (kevin)
- router emit fields (ben)
- billing ingest compute amortized credits (ben/clare)
- console overlay + tooltips (design + frontend)
- add guardrail: routing will surface a "prefetch budget" badge to route owners to avoid accidental thrash

kevin: timeline? I can spike sampling strategy this week. if we keep new fields optional on older events we can deploy router change behind a flag.
clare: I'll draft the ingest logic PR and include small unit tests for amortization math. quick question: should cache credits be negative in any case (refund)? i think no, but call it out.
ajay: no refunds — only credits >= 0. label it explicitly. also add a sentinel for "inferred" credits when router only approximates hits. console should show a caution icon when credits are inferred.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: telemetry-contract-updates -> staging (canary 5%).
ajay: thanks — I'll create a short demo mockup for the overlay and a one-pager describing routing guardrails. tagging @clare and @kevin for follow-up. :thumbsup:
